    GridFsFileSystem
    Adapts MongoDB's GridFS to the generic FileSystem/FileTransfer contracts, so a database's file buckets drive one pane of the two-pane commander — the same WinSCP-style browser (transfer queue, drag-and-drop, quick-view, checksums) already used for SFTP, FTP, S3, Azure and GCS.
